about: The crew's parts (each skinned to the Mathwood people's skeleton and carrying it; made by ~/pw/space-math/rigs/crew-rig/) and the characters put together from them (kit/crew.js makeCrew). A recipe: { suit, head, hair, colours: { job, skin, hair } }; a colour left out keeps the part's own. Any head goes on any suit of the same skeleton, any hair on any head (the attachment rules: ~/pw/space-math/characters/CHARACTERS.md).
